text:
Jordan: Quick sync — ACME pilot kickoff. Need to lock POC success criteria and who owns what by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: Thanks — high level customer asks: 1) semantic search + RAG for internal docs, 2) chat assistant in product with redaction for PII, 3) SLA for 99th pct latency under 500ms for short queries.
Sam: Good callouts. For RAG we should propose: embeddings + vector DB + prefix caching. Will SE own the embed tuning?
Ava: I can own embed tuning and prompt sets. Will need access to sample docs (500-1k docs) and eval prompts by Monday.
Jordan: @Ava great. @Sam can you scope SE hours? We budgeted 20 hrs week 1, 10 hrs week 2. Need confirmation.
Sam: 20/10 looks tight if we also do integration hooks. Requesting 32hrs week 1 for connector + SSO.
Liam: Regarding SSO — ACME requires SAML + SCIM provisioning. Enterprise security questionnaire flagged federation + audit logs as blockers.
Priya: They also asked about data residency (EU). For Hosted we can route to eu-west. Will this affect latency SLO?
Sam: EU routing ok, but increases p99 by ~50ms vs us-west for their users. We should surface that in the SLA doc.
Jordan: Success criteria draft: (a) 80% retrieval accuracy on our eval set, (b) 5 sample flows in product working end-to-end, (c) <500ms p99 for short queries in EU region, (d) security checklist signed. Thoughts?
Ava: Add prompt stability: no more than 2 regressions in NLG quality across 200 eval prompts. I can produce the eval harness.
Liam: From security: they need SOC2+ encryption at rest with customer KMS, plus an answer on whether Private deployment is needed for PII.
Priya: Pricing question from finance: do we show committed Dedicated pricing or hosted usage estimate? Customer is price-sensitive but wants predictability.
Jordan: Propose a 3-month pilot on Hosted with a Dedicated option in month 2 if traffic justifies it. Provide both a consumption estimate and a reserved cost scenario.
Sam: I'll draft a cost model: consumption (tokens+inference-hours) + uplift for EU region + optional Dedicated commit. Will send by EOD.
Ava: Deliverables list: 1) Eval harness + prompt suite (Ava), 2) Connector + SSO proof-of-concept (Sam), 3) Cost model + pricing scenarios (Sam), 4) Security questionnaire answers + KMS doc (Liam), 5) Rollout runbook + handoff (Jordan).
Jordan: Timeline: Week0 (this week) — data & docs ingest; Week1 — embed tuning + SSO POC; Week2 — integration + perf run; Week3 — customer validation & sign-off. Is that realistic?
Sam: Realistic if we get data access today. Otherwise shift each milestone by 3-4 days.
Priya: Customer to provide sample data export + SCIM metadata by Friday. I'll follow up in the CRM.
Liam: Blocker: security team flagged that Hosted option needs a written KMS integration plan for customer to sign. I can draft and need 2 days.
Jordan: Noted. Who owns customer comms on deadlines? @Priya please coordinate.
Priya: On it — I'll send updated timeline and the ask list to ACME by noon PST.
Sam: Quick technical: for eval harness, Ava — can you standardize outputs to JSONL with fields: {"prompt_id","reference","response","score"}?
Ava: Yep, will produce the schema and a sample file.
security-bot: reminder: security questionnaire ticket INC-4521 created and assigned to Liam. Due in 7 days.
Jordan: Final checklist before EOD tomorrow: - Confirm SE hours (Sam) - Customer data access confirmed (Priya) - Eval harness draft (Ava) - Cost model sent (Sam) - KMS integration draft (Liam). If anyone can't meet, ping now.
Priya: I'll confirm data by EOD.
Sam: I'll escalate SE hours if needed, but aiming to hit the numbers.
Ava: Eval harness first draft by EOD.
Liam: KMS doc ready in 48 hrs.
Jordan: Thanks team. I'll compile and send the pilot kickoff packet after you confirm. :rocket:
